heroEyebrow: The CMS that fits on any PHP host
heroDescription: CometCMS is a visual page builder and content CMS in a single PHP folder. No database, no Composer, no Node on the server. Upload it to any shared host, open /admin, and start building.
overviewBuilder: Design pages visually with sections, columns, blocks and field bindings. Editors fill in content while the design stays consistent.
overviewHeadless: Content types with custom fields for text, media, relations and dates, served to any frontend through a JSON API.
overviewMcp: Let an AI agent manage content through the built-in MCP endpoint, and build API queries in the admin.
builderDescription: What you see on the canvas is what visitors get. Drag in sections and blocks, click any element to edit it, and bind it to your content fields. Pages are rendered by PHP on your server, cached, and ship JavaScript only where a block needs it.
builderTemplates: Templates own the design of every entry in a content type, so a new blog post or event looks right the moment it is published. Need more blocks? Extensions add testimonials, pricing, maps, slideshows, stats and theme presets.
bindFieldsDescription: Headings and images pull from your content.
everyLanguageDescription: One design, translated content, own URLs.
headlessDescription: Don’t need a website? Model your content with custom fields, switch on API access and feed Next.js, Astro or a mobile app. Scoped tokens decide exactly who may read or change what.
fieldsDescription: Build content types from text, rich text, media, relations, selects, dates, repeaters and more. Every entry is stored as a plain JSON file, so there is no database to set up, migrate or lose.
apiTitle: Build the query, copy the URL.
apiDescription: Leave the Page Builder off and serve a content type through the REST API. Pick filters, sorting and a locale in the admin, then copy a ready-to-use URL or curl command.
tokensDescription: Grant tokens by action, content type, entry, media category and field. A booking system can update capacity without touching anything else.
integrationsDescription: Let your coding agent manage content over MCP, and keep static frontends fresh with signed webhooks the moment something is published.
mcpTitle: Let your agent run the CMS.
mcpDescription: A Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint ships inside the PHP install. Agents can model content types, write entries and edit page layouts, with no Node or extra server.
mcpRequest: Add a “Type & Color Workshop” on July 9 with 16 seats and close registration.
mcpResponse: Created and published in Events. It shows up in the API and on /events right away.
webhooksDescription: Notify any HTTPS endpoint when entries are created, updated, published, unpublished, deleted or restored. Trigger a static site rebuild or sync another system, with every payload signed.
useCasesDescription: Start from the sample website or an empty workspace. Shape content types around your project and publish it as a site, an API, or both.
websitesTitle: Launch a site on any host.
websitesItem1: Build landing pages, about pages and menus in the visual builder.
websitesItem2: Share one header, footer and theme across every page.
blogsItem1: Write posts with rich text, media and categories.
blogsItem2: Schedule publication and list posts with search and pagination.
eventsItem1: Model events, products or team members with custom fields.
eventsItem2: Filter and sort lists by date, category or any field.
languagesItem1: Translate builder content and structured fields per locale.
languagesItem2: Give each language its own URLs, with hreflang and sitemap entries.
headlessItem1: Expose content types to Next.js, Astro or mobile apps.
headlessItem2: Filter, sort and resolve locales with a clean JSON API.
formsItem1: Turn a content type into a form with your own messages.
formsItem2: Review incoming entries right in the CMS.
ctaDescription: Download the ZIP, upload it to any PHP host, and finish setup in the browser. No SSH, no CLI, no environment variables.
licenseNote: Free & open source · Apache 2.0 · No database
themeLabel: Switch between light and dark theme
